<!-- pr-reviewer: 374e538c6114d9fbe0e1e5e43ef38528e2972451 -->

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good
- One focused commit. It changes one condition in `judged()` (crates/sim/src/verify/solid.rs:257). The rule now reads: `(stack_only || ex.vertical_rapids_only) && axis.is_none() && m.arc.is_none() && m.from.x == m.to.x && m.from.y == m.to.y && m.to.z >= m.from.z`.
- The envelope sweep now shares the lift-out-of-the-kerf rule with `stack_hits`. The shank and holder sweep the full lift; the edge is judged by its rise column above its top; the start pose stays with the law of the cut. Descents and rapids that do not start at a cut keep the full sweep, so the #4062 canopy fault is still refused.
- A pin test in the existing canopy suite (crates/sim/tests/vertical_rapid_part.rs:107) that fails without the fix and passes with it. Verified locally.
- A decision record (docs/decisions/4211-envelope-lift-from-cut.md) that says what is kept, what is dropped and why.
- No new dependencies, no process files, no UI, no golden or snapshot changes.

Results merged with main
- Runner (self-hosted macOS, run 45889580646, trial-merged with main 1c0152c91, merged: true):
  - Quick gate (on the merged tree): 11 steps, 0 failed - sim build; sim suites lib, mark_retract, midmove_pose, vertical_rapid_part; motion solid_law; app build; app suites probe_reach, real_tip_contour, thread_mill_rim, tool_body_drill_probe.
  - Clippy on camcraft-sim (`--all-targets -- -D warnings`): clean.
- Local (own worktree, trial merge: "Already up to date", main 1c0152c91):
  - Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`, release): 6 steps, 0 failed - light build 937s; motion lib 352s (8 light tests); motion adaptive_troch_island 46s; motion adaptive_troch_neck 17s; motion adaptive_troch_parallel 11s; app pocket_pass_start 3s. Wall 22.9 min.
  - The red-main pinning suite `camcraft-motion finish3d_hop_height`: 5/5 passed (3 of 5 were red on main before the fix).
  - The new pin `a_retract_from_a_finish_touch_on_the_wall_stays_clear`: fails without the fix with `[RapidInPart { at: 1 }]`; passes with it.
- Example catalog: not run - no post or toolpath change.
- Targeted heavy step: not owed - this is a P2 red-main fix, not a P1 under the safety floor. No `<!-- heavy-wave -->` record is needed.

Requested before merge
- None.

Notes (not blocking)
- The quick gate does not map `finish3d_hop_height`, so that suite was verified locally. The runner run is macOS; the author's quick gate was Windows. The diff adds no cfg(windows) lines or per-OS pins, so no Windows-only readings are owed.
- The author's body says the light lane was not run. I ran it locally on this head: green.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
